pages.text: Livestock trailers carry cows, sheep, pigs, goats, horses, donkeys, mules, llamas and chickens. Each pen holds one horse, two cows, or four chickens.$(br2)Parked, the back gate drops down as a $(l)ramp$().
Lead animals up the ramp on leads and they walk in. You get the leads back.

$(li)Right-click the trailer with animals following on leads to load them all.$(li)Right-click with an empty hand to let them all out down the ramp.$(li)Right-click with a lead to take the last one out on it.$(br2)Inside, they ride along between the slats.
Animals ride wherever the trailer goes.
